name: chartwright
description: Evergreen chart and graph skills: an evidence-based knowledge base of chart types (when to use, what each excels at, when not to, substitutes, perceptual evidence, notes) and render targets (Markdown/Mermaid, web with Vega-Lite, Plotly and Chart.js, static PNG/SVG via Python), a deterministic chooser and builder CLI that takes data by file reference to save tokens, and a curation skill that researches novel chart requests and grows the knowledge base so the next request is cheaper.
